{{/* Confirmation Input Component - "type X to confirm" pattern for dangerous actions Parameters: - id (required): Input id - targetValue (required): The value user must type to enable the button - buttonId (required): The id of the button to enable/disable - label (optional): Label text (default: "Type [targetValue] to confirm:") - placeholder (optional): Input placeholder text - caseSensitive (optional): Whether match is case-sensitive (default: false) - class (optional): Additional CSS classes Usage: {{template "vendor/partials/confirmation_input.html" (dict "id" "disconnectConfirm" "targetValue" "DISCONNECT" "buttonId" "disconnectBtn" "placeholder" "Type DISCONNECT" )}} Note: This component includes the JavaScript event listener to enable/disable the target button based on input matching. */}} {{/* Set defaults */}} {{$label := .label}} {{if not $label}}{{$label = printf "Type \"%s\" to confirm:" .targetValue}}{{end}} {{$caseSensitive := .caseSensitive}} {{/* Stratus Design System */}}
